messages:
nina: Quick note 1: launching a micro experiment on pricing page tonight. Goal: shorten FAQ bullets, rename a tier label, and route high-value calculator leads straight to AEs. Thoughts?

sam: Short and sweet. What's the A/B split?

nina: 50/50. Two-week window. Metrics: support volume, CTA clicks, estimator dropoff, inbound SLA.

evan: Proposed label: 'Reserved capacity' (full) and card label 'Reserved'. Tooltip: 'Monthly GPU commitment for guaranteed throughput and predictable cost.'

talia: UX check 1: ensure tooltip accessible and doesn't overflow on mobile.

nina: Agreed. Add to QA checklist.

nina: Routing rule for staging: if estimator.segment == 'enterprise' -> AE_queue_high; elif annual_commit >= 15000 -> AE_queue_med; else -> SDR_queue.

devops-bot: lead-router: staging rules applied at 2026-03-23T01:02:10Z (rule id LR-0323-9)

sam: I'll create the experiment in Optimizely and wire tracking.

evan: I'll draft the launch post and include dashboards. Review welcome.

talia: I'll review accessibility and mobile behavior tomorrow morning.

nina: If no objections by EOD we'll flip to canary. Thanks all. :rocket:
